root.label: Yankees beat Red Sox 9-2 in Aug. 29, 2026 doubleheader nightcap

events.label: Yankees beat Red Sox 9-2 in Aug. 29, 2026 doubleheader nightcap

slots.name: Yankees runs
slots.sentence: Jazz Chisholm and rookie Spencer Jones added sacrifice flies as New York scored at least seven runs for the fourth time in its last seven games.

slots.name: Boston runs
slots.sentence: Ceddanne Rafaela hit an RBI single in a four-run ninth as Boston beat New York 6-0 in the opener.

slots.name: season series games
slots.sentence: The Yankees evened the season series at six games apiece and moved three games ahead of the Red Sox for the AL’s top wild-card spot.

slots.name: eighth inning hits
slots.sentence: After Brent Headrick stranded Willson Contreras at third following the Boston first baseman’s triple, the Yankees had seven hits in the eighth and opened a 9-2 lead.

slots.name: Yankees hits
slots.sentence: Rice hit a tying single in New York’s three-run third off Brayan Bello (5-7) and capped the big inning with a two-run single for New York’s 13th hit

slots.name: Luis García hits
slots.sentence: Luis García had three hits and added a bases-loaded groundout to give the Yankees the lead.

slots.name: Alec Gamboa pitches
slots.sentence: After opener Alec Gamboa threw 18 pitches to five hitters, Bello permitted four runs and five hits in 4 1/3 innings

slots.name: Yankees scoring frequency
slots.sentence: Amed Rosario had an RBI single and Austin Wells added a two-run single as the Yankees scored nine runs for the fifth time since the All-Star break

slots.name: Max Fried pitches
slots.sentence: The left-hander struck out four and walked one while throwing 63 pitches in his first start since Aug. 13.

slots.name: Ben Rice RBIs
slots.sentence: Ben Rice had a two-run single in New York’s five-run eighth inning and finished with three RBIs as the Yankees beat the Boston Red Sox 9-2 Saturday in the nightcap and earned a doubleheader split.

slots.name: Max Fried hits allowed
slots.sentence: Coming off a second injured list stint due to a bone bruise in his left elbow, Max Fried allowed one run and three hits in 3 2/3 innings.
